status: 11月23日复核：马德什省首席部长任命尚须在规定期限内取得信任投票，未公布ICT项目、采购或厂商决定。尼印总理国事访问已结束，双方发布联合新闻稿和《Viksit Bharat and Samunnat Nepal》联合愿景：已交换南亚卫星SATCOM网络合作谅解备忘录，并把数字尼泊尔框架、跨境零售支付、数字园区和数据中心、5G/6G等列入合作方向；具体项目、实施方式、预算、采购与供应商均仍待后续协商或公告，不能据此推定订单或中标。Bolpatra两项ICT公告／澄清仍须在开标、评标和授标记录发布后续核验。往期完整保留。
statusEn: 23 November review: the Madhesh Chief Minister appointment still requires a confidence vote within the constitutional period and discloses no ICT project, procurement or vendor decision. Nepal's Prime Ministerial state visit to India has concluded with a joint press release and the Viksit Bharat and Samunnat Nepal Joint Vision: an MoU on a South Asia Satellite SATCOM network was exchanged, while the Digital Nepal Framework, cross-border retail payments, digital parks and data centres, and 5G/6G are cooperation directions. Specific projects, implementation modalities, budgets, procurement and suppliers remain subject to consultation or later disclosure, so this is not evidence of an order or award. The two Bolpatra ICT notice/clarification records still require follow-up against opening, evaluation and award records. Previous issues remain intact.
summary: 移民局为主数据中心发布虚拟化／Hypervisor及负载均衡与WAF支持续保采购；为NCB两信封程序，尚无投标人、预算或授标信息。
总理和部长会议办公室更正ICT设备采购的开标时间；桌面电脑、笔记本、打印机、扫描仪、投影等数量已列明，但没有厂商或中标方。
马德什省首席部长已依宪法程序任命；该省级人事变动须在规定期限内取得信任投票，尚无ICT或采购决定披露。
尼印国事访问已形成联合愿景并交换南亚卫星SATCOM网络合作谅解备忘录；数字尼泊尔框架、跨境零售支付、数字园区和数据中心、5G/6G列为合作方向，但具体项目、采购和厂商尚未披露。
所有本期项目均为公告／澄清阶段，不能推断中兴、思科、华为或任何其他设备商已参与、入围或中标。
summaryEn: The Department of Immigration has published an NCB two-envelope procurement for its primary data centre's virtualisation/Hypervisor solution and load-balancer/WAF support and warranty renewal; bidders, budget and award are not disclosed.

The Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers corrected the opening time for its ICT-equipment procurement. Quantities for desktops, laptops, printers, scanners and projectors are listed, but no brand, bidder or winner is named.

Madhesh Province has appointed a Chief Minister under the constitutional fallback procedure. The provincial leadership change requires a confidence vote within the constitutional period and has no disclosed ICT or procurement decision.

The Nepal–India state visit produced a Joint Vision and an MoU on a South Asia Satellite SATCOM network. The Digital Nepal Framework, cross-border retail payments, digital parks and data centres, and 5G/6G are named cooperation directions, but specific projects, procurement and suppliers are not disclosed.
All current entries are notice or clarification stage. They do not establish participation, shortlisting or an award for ZTE, Cisco, Huawei or any other supplier.

items.title: 移民局发布主数据中心虚拟化及负载均衡／WAF支持续保采购
items.titleEn: Department of Immigration publishes primary data-centre virtualisation and LB/WAF support procurement
items.badge: 官方 e-GP 公告 · NCB 两信封
items.text: PPMO的Bolpatra官方项目记录显示，移民局于11月17日发布编号24-27-03001/DOI/G/NCB-05/2083-84的货物采购，用于其主数据中心的虚拟化／Hypervisor方案及负载均衡与WAF支持和续保。价格表列为一套、两年支持和续保；采用国内竞争性招标（NCB）和技术／财务两信封程序。公开记录列出11月23日13:00（尼泊尔时间）预投标会议、12月8日12:00截止、14:00开标。状态仍为已发布，两个信封均处于密封状态；未公开预算、投标人、设备厂家或授标结果。
items.textEn: PPMO's official Bolpatra record shows that the Department of Immigration published goods procurement 24-27-03001/DOI/G/NCB-05/2083-84 on 17 November for its primary data centre's virtualisation/Hypervisor solution and load-balancer/WAF support and warranty renewal. The price schedule lists one package with two years of support and warranty. It uses national competitive bidding (NCB) and technical/financial two-envelope submission. The public record lists a 23 November 13:00 Nepal-time pre-bid meeting, a 8 December 12:00 deadline and 14:00 opening. It remains published with both envelopes sealed; budget, bidders, equipment maker and award are not disclosed.
items.opportunity: 研判：客户和需求明确为移民局主数据中心的虚拟化、流量分发与应用防护生命周期支持，当前仅处于正式招标而非授标。下一步应阅读完整技术规范，重点核对虚拟化兼容性、迁移与回退、LB/WAF性能与接口、支持SLA及验收；预投标澄清后再判断资格和方案边界。竞对与风险：公告没有公布现网品牌、投标人或预算，不能把任何既有厂商、渠道商或安全产品推定为参与方。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: the customer and need are specific—primary-data-centre virtualisation, traffic delivery and application protection lifecycle support—but the project is at formal tender, not award, stage. Read the full specification and clarify virtualisation compatibility, migration and rollback, LB/WAF performance and interfaces, support SLA and acceptance before defining scope or eligibility. Competition and risk: the notice identifies neither incumbent brand, bidder nor budget; no current supplier, channel partner or security product can be inferred to be participating.

items.title: 总理和部长会议办公室更正ICT设备采购的开标时间
items.titleEn: PMO corrects the opening time for its ICT-equipment procurement
items.badge: 官方 e-GP 澄清 · NCB 单信封
items.text: 总理和部长会议办公室的Bolpatra项目记录显示，ICT设备采购OPMCM/02/NCB/ICTE/083/84于11月5日发布；11月18日的修正说明将IFB第6项的开标时间更正为11月27日14:00（尼泊尔时间）。项目仍显示11月27日12:00提交截止，并采用NCB单信封程序。公开价格表列出14台台式机、5台笔记本、3台重载一体机、12台一体机打印机、扫描仪、75英寸电视和投影仪等；未披露金额、品牌、投标人或中标方。
items.textEn: The Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers' Bolpatra record shows that ICT-equipment procurement OPMCM/02/NCB/ICTE/083/84 was published on 5 November. A 18 November correction sets the IFB item-6 opening time to 27 November 14:00 Nepal time. The record still shows a 27 November 12:00 submission deadline and an NCB single-envelope procedure. Its public price schedule lists 14 desktops, five laptops, three heavy-duty all-in-one printers, 12 all-in-one printers, scanners, 75-inch displays and projectors, among other equipment; amount, brands, bidders and winner are not disclosed.
items.opportunity: 研判：这是办公终端和文印／展示设备的正式采购澄清，需求清单可用于准备供货、保修、安装、兼容性和交付支持方案，但不等于已经选择任何OEM。下一步在11月27日后核对开标、评标和授标记录，并以技术规格、品牌等效条款和售后要求判断可竞争范围。竞对：当前公开材料没有厂商、代理商或投标名单，不能把中国厂商、思科或其他品牌标为项目参与者。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: this is a formal clarification for end-user computing, printing and presentation equipment. The published bill of quantities can inform supply, warranty, installation, compatibility and delivery preparation, but does not select an OEM. After 27 November, verify opening, evaluation and award records, then assess competitive scope against the technical specification, brand-or-equivalent language and after-sales requirements. Competition: the public material names no manufacturer, reseller or bidder; Chinese vendors, Cisco and other brands cannot be labelled participants.

items.title: 马德什省任命萨罗杰·库马尔·亚达夫为首席部长
items.titleEn: Madhesh Province appoints Saroj Kumar Yadav Chief Minister
items.badge: 公共广播报道＋独立媒体交叉核验 · 省级人事任命
items.badgeEn: Public-broadcaster report cross-checked by independent media · provincial appointment
items.text: Radio Nepal与《加德满都邮报》报道，马德什省省长苏伦德拉·拉布·卡尔纳于11月21日依据尼泊尔宪法第168(3)条，任命人民社会党尼泊尔（JSP Nepal）议会党团领袖萨罗杰·库马尔·亚达夫为首席部长。报道说，在第168(2)条规定的期限内，没有政党或省议会议员提出获得至少两党支持的组阁主张；因此由省议会最大党的议会党团领袖获任命。亚达夫需在宪法规定期限内向省议会寻求信任投票。《加德满都邮报》11月22日报道其已宣誓就职。现有报道未披露任何ICT政策、项目、采购、预算或厂商决定。
items.textEn: Radio Nepal and The Kathmandu Post reported that Madhesh Province Chief Surendra Labh Karna appointed Janata Samajbadi Party Nepal (JSP Nepal) parliamentary leader Saroj Kumar Yadav Chief Minister on 21 November under Article 168(3) of Nepal's Constitution. They report that no party or provincial assembly member lodged a government-formation claim with support from at least two parties within the Article 168(2) deadline, so the parliamentary leader of the largest party in the provincial assembly was appointed. Yadav must seek a vote of confidence in the provincial assembly within the constitutional period. The Kathmandu Post reported on 22 November that he had taken the oath of office. The available reporting discloses no ICT policy, project, procurement, budget or vendor decision.
items.opportunity: 研判：这是省级政府领导层变化，不是联邦内阁决定，也不构成ICT商机或采购信号。其实际政策影响取决于信任投票以及后续省级内阁和预算安排。下一步应核对省议会信任投票结果和马德什省政府正式发布的内阁、预算及数字服务／基础设施决定；在有正式文件前，不能把人事任命推断为项目重启、资金承诺或任何设备商机会。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: this is a change in provincial leadership, not a federal Cabinet decision and not an ICT opportunity or procurement signal. Its practical policy effect depends on the confidence vote and subsequent provincial cabinet and budget arrangements. Next, verify the provincial assembly confidence-vote result and official Madhesh government decisions on the cabinet, budget and digital services or infrastructure. Until formal records emerge, the appointment cannot be treated as a project restart, funding commitment or an opportunity for any equipment vendor.

items.title: 尼印国事访问形成联合愿景并交换卫星通信合作谅解备忘录
items.titleEn: Nepal–India state visit produces Joint Vision and SATCOM-network MoU
items.badge: 尼泊尔外交部＋印度总理办公室联合新闻稿 · 已公布成果
items.badgeEn: Nepal MoFA + Indian PMO joint release · published outcome
items.text: 尼泊尔外交部和印度总理办公室11月23日发布的联合新闻稿确认，巴伦德拉·沙阿总理于11月22—23日访印期间，双方通过《Viksit Bharat and Samunnat Nepal》联合愿景，将实体与数字互联互通、良好治理、技术／空间／创新等纳入合作路线图。文件列明：将加快印度UPI与尼泊尔国家支付系统衔接后的跨境零售支付实施；围绕数字尼泊尔框架交换数字身份、支付和电子政务的技术经验；推动数字园区和数据中心的私人投资；加强AI、卫星、5G/6G和下一代网络合作。双方同时交换了印度空间研究组织（ISRO）与尼泊尔信息通信部关于利用南亚卫星建立卫星通信（SATCOM）网络的谅解备忘录。联合新闻稿还说明印度将提供15000亿卢比（约24000亿尼泊尔卢比）发展援助，其中11500亿卢比为能源项目卢比贷款额度；具体项目及提供方式仍须双方协商确定。文件未公布SATCOM网络的范围、预算、技术路线、实施时间、采购程序或任何设备／服务供应商。
items.textEn: The 23 November joint releases from Nepal's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and India's Prime Minister's Office confirm that Prime Minister Balendra Shah's 22–23 November visit produced the Viksit Bharat and Samunnat Nepal Joint Vision. It places physical and digital connectivity, good governance, and technology/space/innovation on a cooperation roadmap. It calls for expedited cross-border retail payments after the linkage of India's UPI and Nepal's national payment system; exchange of digital-identity, payments and e-governance expertise for the Digital Nepal Framework; facilitation of private investment in digital parks and data centres; and cooperation on AI, space, 5G/6G and next-generation networks. The sides also exchanged an ISRO–Nepal Ministry of Information and Communication MoU to establish a South Asia Satellite SATCOM network. The joint release says India will provide INR 15,000 crore (NPR 24,000 crore) in development assistance, of which INR 11,500 crore is a rupee-denominated line of credit for energy projects; specific projects and modalities remain for mutual consultation. It does not disclose SATCOM-network scope, budget, architecture, implementation timing, procurement or any equipment or service supplier.
items.opportunity: 研判：这是已公开的政策与合作框架，并含一项卫星通信谅解备忘录，但不是设备采购、项目授标或厂商选择。应建立四条可核验的后续线索：（1）尼泊尔信息通信部／NTA与ISRO对SATCOM网络的实施文件、频率与地面段安排；（2）尼泊尔国家支付系统与UPI的跨境零售支付上线、监管和参与机构公告；（3）数字园区和数据中心的具体项目、土地／能源／数据治理要求及招标；（4）5G/6G或Digital Nepal Framework的联合工作计划、预算和开放采购。援助总额及能源贷款不能自动转化为ICT预算；在技术规范、资金安排或采购公告披露前，不把中兴、华为、思科、浩鲸、亚信或任何其他供应商标为参与方或受益方。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: this is a published policy and cooperation framework, including one SATCOM MoU; it is not equipment procurement, a project award or a supplier selection. Maintain four verifiable follow-up tracks: (1) implementation papers, spectrum and ground-segment arrangements from Nepal's Ministry of Information and Communication/NTA and ISRO; (2) launch, regulatory and participating-institution notices for UPI–Nepal cross-border retail payments; (3) defined digital-park and data-centre projects, land/energy/data-governance requirements and tenders; and (4) joint work plans, budgets and open procurement for 5G/6G or the Digital Nepal Framework. The assistance total and energy credit cannot be converted automatically into an ICT budget. Until specifications, funding arrangements or procurement notices are published, ZTE, Huawei, Cisco, H3C, AsiaInfo and any other supplier must not be labelled participant or beneficiary.
